description: Evaluation framework for Pydantic AI agents using pytest markers, pairwise comparison, and baseline readout reports.
rules: Decorate test functions with @pytest.mark.assay(generator=my_generator, evaluator=MyEvaluator()) — generator returns a Dataset, evaluator defaults to BradleyTerryEvaluator()
Assay tests receive an AssayContext via the context parameter — iterate over context.dataset.cases to access each Case's inputs and expected_output
Agent.run() calls inside an assay test are automatically captured — just call your Pydantic AI agent normally, no extra instrumentation needed
Run with --assay-mode=new_baseline first to record baseline responses, then --assay-mode=evaluate (default) to compare novel responses against the baseline
Custom evaluators are async callables with signature (EvaluatorInput) -> Readout — implement __call__ to define your own evaluation logic
BradleyTerryEvaluator and PairwiseEvaluator both accept a model and criterion parameter to configure the judge LLM and comparison question
